name: Haus Elisabeth
beschreibung:
Sunnily situated in Neustift, Haus Elisabeth provides comfortable rooms and holiday apartments showcasing views of the Stubai Alps. It is a welcoming base for hikers and skiers.

The Elfer ski lifts, the Stubai Glacier, and cross-country trails are within easy reach.
kurzbeschreibung: Haus Elisabeth in Neustift im Stubaital offers cosy comfort and alpine panoramas.
